en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a small coastal town beside a bay or inlet, with wooden houses scattered along the shoreline and up low hills. Forested hills surround the settlement. In the foreground are a few larger houses and utility poles; in the distance a church-like building appears among other homes. The words "Ljungkile" are printed in the lower left, and a photographer/publisher credit with a number appears in the lower right.
